const offset = 2;
function prefix(value) {
    return value + 1;
}
class Counter {
    constructor(value){
        this.total = value;
    }
    read = function(delta) {
        return this.total + delta;
    };
    static combine = function(value) {
        return value * 2;
    };
    method(delta) {
        return this.total + delta;
    }
}
function exercise(value) {
    const counter = new Counter(prefix(value));
    return counter.read(offset) + Counter.combine(value) + counter.method(offset);
}
